  "pros": [
    "Intuitive deal flow for managing sales opportunities.",
    "Effective in improving overall sales productivity.",
    "Consolidates many sales tools into one platform for efficiency."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Reporting features are not robust enough for detailed analysis.",
    "Lacks automatic reminders for critical sales tasks.",
    "Experienced historically poor customer support when issues arose."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Information Technology Project Lead found Freshsales generally effective for managing their sales workflow, appreciating its intuitive deal flow and consolidated platform. However, they were frustrated by the lack of robust reporting capabilities and the absence of automatic reminders, which impacted their project oversight. The historical issues with customer support also presented a significant challenge during their 1-2 years of use."
